answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after a history of honest completed trades, like a comet earning its tail over many orbits rather than appearing overnight. A newcomer starts in a narrow canyon of low-value tasks, and only proven work opens the wider meadow of high-value contracts. Spawning a thousand fake identities then means funding a thousand stakes and doing a thousand honest jobs first, which costs more than any fraud could recover.
